Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that brings us to an end to this New Zealand's tour of Scotland. The Kiwis have dominated the proceedings and it shows the great depth in their side. Scotland, on the other hand, would like to use this experience to get better in future. There is lot of cricketing action to looks forward to though as we have Women's cricket in the Commonwealth games. Indian men's team will be taking on West Indies on 1st of August in the second T20I. Exciting cricket is all around us. Do join us for the same. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Mitchell Santner, the skipper of New Zealand says that it was a pretty good show from his boys and he is happy with the chase. He says he is happy with the bowling performance as they got 5 wickets pretty quickly. He also says that they had Scotland in their grasp but let them away a bit at the end. He adds that 300 was a par score on this ground and praised Chapman and Mitchell for the way they batted and finished the game.

Richie Berrington, the skipper of Scotland says that there was a lot of good stuff from them today. Adds that in the first innings, they missed out on getting to 350 after the start they got. Credits Cross and Leask for the way they played and with 300 on the board, they were in with a good chance. Tells that, unfortunately, they did not manage to get wickets in the middle and for them, it is back to the basics and they would like to take this experience and build on this in future.

Mark Chapman is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his superb unbeaten century He says that it is nice to be out there in the middle, score runs and win the game for the side. He says he is delighted with the ton and says that he had a chat with Mitchell who said to him to play his natural attacking game. He adds that it was about taking the game deep and then find one or two big over to take the game away. He ends by saying that they were confident at the innings break because the wicket looked good and they backed themselves to chase down the total.
Presentation time...

Earlier in the day, Scotland were in big trouble when they were 5 down for a 100 or so. However, Leask played a blinder and he received good support from the likes of Cross and Watt and that saw them going over 300. Michael Bracewell bowled quite well for the Kiwis, utilizing the spin that was on offer in this wicket but credit should go to the New Zealand batters for chasing this down with such ease in the end.

Scotland were quite impatient with the ball, there was enough in this wicket to cause problems but they just bowled too many boundary balls which did not let them build the pressure. The spinners too bowled well in parts and they’ll be disappointed with how things went in the second innings. Leask bowled well after his brilliant batting performance earlier in the day but they needed a more clinical display with the ball.

The top three provided them with the start they needed but when the third wicket fell, the game was still in the balance. Then though came the match winning stand between Chapman and Mitchell. The former scored a brilliant ton and the latter played as the perfect foil to round off a lovely chase.
A superb win for the Kiwis! A really good chase on a wicket which wasn’t easy to bat on. The key here was sensible batting and that is what New Zealand did.

That's it, Chapman takes the single and New Zealand win this game by seven wickets! This is a slower full delivery on middle. Chapman looks to work it towards the leg side. However, he gets a leading edge that goes over the bowler's head and a single is taken as the mid on fielder cuts it off.
Shorter delivery on off. Mitchell pulls it to deep square leg for a single. Scores are level now!

There it is! First ODI century for Mark Chapman! What a knock this has been, he came into the crease with his team under pressure but never looked like in any trouble. Paced his innings to perfection and truly deserves all the applause from his team-mates and the crowd here. Back of a length, around off. Chapman chops it to backward point and takes a quick single.
Moves onto 99 now! This is full and outside off. Chapman drives it to deep extra-cover for a couple. Just 3 needed now!
On a length, on middle. Chapman works it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
A fuller and flatter one on off. Mitchell blocks it off the front foot.
This is angled on leg. Chapman looks to scoop it but misses. The bal hits the keeper's pad and deflects it towards short fine leg. A bye taken.
This is full on leg. Mitchell sweeps it fine towards short fine leg for a single.
Very full, on off. Mitchell drives it back to the bowler.
WIDE! Full and drifting down the leg side. Mitchell looks to sweep it but misses.
Fuller on middle. Chapman drives it to long on for a single.

FOUR! Another reverse-sweep and another boundary! This is tad shorter in length, on middle. Chapman does not go on his knee completely but plays the reverse-sweep and hits it in the gap towards the backward point fence.
A slower short ball, around off. Mitchell tries to pull it but mistimes it towards the off side.
SIX! It's Mitchell's turn now as he slams this down the ground. This is in the slot on middle. Mitchell goes deep in his crease and tonks it into the sightscreen straight down the ground.
Sole tries a bouncer again, on middle and Chapman pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
A full delivery, it is a slower one and Chapman works it to mid-wicket.
Keeps it short, on middle. Mitchell clears his front leg and heaves it to deep square leg for a single.
Bangs it short and it is around leg. Mitchell looks to pull it away but the ball kisses some part of his hand and goes off the bounce to the keeper.

SIX! Mark Chapman wants to finish this game early now! This is tossed up, on off. Chapman dances down the track, reaches the pitch of the ball and hammers it over long off for a maximum. Just 23 needed now!
Angling into leg. Mitchell works it to short fine leg for a single.

DROPPED! Scotland have been very sloppy in the field and this has cost them dearly. Tahir floats it up from 'round the wicket on middle, Mark Chapman goes for the big shot again but this time top edges it high in the air. Michael Leask at long off comes running towards it, settles in but drops it at the end. Three runs taken.

SIX! Back to back maximums for Chapman. This is floated full and again on middle, Mark Chapman uses his feet again and lofts it high towards the long off. The fielder there watches it agonisingly go over him and for a maximum.
SIX! Up, up and away! This is tossed up on middle, Mark Chapman skips down the track and smokes it over the long off fence for a biggie.
On the shorter side, on leg. Chapman works it towards the leg side.
Goes fuller on middle. Mitchell reverse-sweeps it to backward point.
On the shorter side, around off. Chapman punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
On the shorter side, on leg. Mitchell tucks it behind square on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! This is on off and fuller. Mitchell reverse-sweeps it and does it fine as the ball races away towards the third man fence.
Quicker and drifting into the pads. Mitchell works it to square leg.

Tough chance but Scotland need to take those if they want to make their way back in this game. This is fuller on middle. Chapman sweeps and gets a top edge of his blade. The ball goes in the aire behind mid-wicket and Jones runs behind it to catch it. He almost covers the ground but ends up dropping it in the end. A single taken.
On the shorter side, around off. Chapman punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! He is playing quite beautifully out there! This is angled into leg and Chapman gets low to just paddle it fine and the ball races away towards the fine leg fence.
Shorterv in length, on off. Chapman pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
This is flatter on middle. Chapma goes for the reverse-sweep but gets just a glove on it. The ball loops up in the air and falls just short of the bowler as he dives forward to catch it.
Goes fuller and outside off. Chapman square drives it to point.
Tossed up, on middle. Mitchell skips down the track and works it wide of long on for a single.

We are in the back end of this innings as only 10 overs are left now. New Zealand looks in full control of this run chase. Scotland need wickets to have any chance of turning this game around. Let's see if Mark Watt can provide a breakthrough as he comes back into the attack now.
Powerplay 3 time. One extra fielder, i.e. 5 can now be put outside the 30-yard circle till the end of this game.
Flatter delivery on off. Chapman pushes it back to the bowler.
Pushed quicker on middle. Chapman just defends it towards the leg side.
Tossed up on middle. Chapman works it towards the leg side.

SIX! Wow! What a shot! This is slower through the air and fuller around off. Chapman skips down the track, makes a bit of room and plays a glorious inside-out lofted drive over deep extra-cover for a maximum.
Bowls it short and wide outside off again. Mitchell this time cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Shorter in length and around off. Chapman cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Michael Leask (6-0-31-2) comes back into the attack.
On a length, angling into leg from 'round the wicket. Chapman glances it to deep square leg for a single. 68 needed now from 66 balls!
Play and a miss! Serves a length delivery, outside off. Chapman throws his bat at it but misses.
Sole bangs it short, on middle. Mitchell pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Firmly hit! Sole continues to keep it a tad short, on off. Mitchell backs away and slaps it past mid on for a boundary.
Back of a length, around leg. Chapman looks to pull it but only gets some part  of his blade as the ball goes to short fine leg for a single.
Sole bowls it a tad short on middle. Mitchell pulls it to deep backward square leg for a single. 100-run stand comes up!
On a length and on off. Mitchell drives it right of the bowler. Sharif gets a hand to it but does not stop it completely and a single is taken as the ball goes behind him.
Tad fuller and around off. Mitchell pushes it towards the off side.
Angling into middle and leg. This is on a length and Mitchell works it to mid-wicket.
Now, Chapman gets to his fifty! He is grabbing this opportunity with both hands. This is on a length, on leg. Chapman works it to deep square leg for a single.
On a length, on middle and leg. Chapman works it towards the leg side.
Fifty for Daryl Mitchell! He continues to excel with the bat. A fluent knock this. A length delivery on off. Mitchell just defends it with the soft hands towards the off side for a single.
Goes fuller on middle. Mitchell drives it right of mid on for a single. 79 needed now from 78 balls!
Runs are coming easily for the Kiwis now! This is on the pads. Mitchell works it towards the backward square leg region for a couple.
Angling into leg. Chapman works it to square leg for a single.
A flatter one on middle. Chapman blocks it out.
SIX! This time he clears the fence! On middle and fuller. Chapman slog-sweeps it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
FOUR! Nicely played! This is fuller on middle. Chapman brings out the reverse-sweep and hits it in the gap through backward point for a boundary.

FOUR! Inside edge but it goes just past the diving keeper for a boundary! Back of a length, around off. It nips back in a bit and catches the inside edge of Mitchell's blade as he looks to drive it away. The ball runs away towards the fine leg fence.
Fuller one and on middle, Daryl Mitchell tries to flick it but miscues it.
Back of a length delivery, Daryl Mitchell stays back and clips it through square leg for a brace.
A bit slower and on middle, Daryl Mitchell looks to block it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
On a length and on off, Daryl Mitchell taps it to point.
FOUR! Lucky boundary for Mitchell. This is on a length and on middle and leg, Daryl Mitchell tries to loft it down the ground but gets an inside edge wide of mid on. The ball races away to the fence.
Drinks break. This partnership has taken New Zealand to the safer shores. Both the batters are looking quite comfortable in the middle and Scotland need wickets quickly here. Can they fightback here?
Quicker once again but onto the pads, Mark Chapman tucks it to short fine leg.
Quicker one and on off, Mark Chapman guides it to point.
Short and on middle and leg, Daryl Mitchell flicks it to square leg for one.
FOUR! Nice use of the feet there. This is floated on middle, Daryl Mitchell dances down the track and lofts it towards the vacant deep square leg fence for a boundary.
In the air but safe! This is tossed up full and on middle, Daryl Mitchell goes for the sweep but gets a top edge and the ball falls safely in the fine leg region. Two runs taken.
On middle, blocked out.
A slower one, full and on middle, Mark Chapman knocks it back to the bowler. A good over fro Scotland as they conceded only two runs.
Fullish delivery on middle and leg, Mark Chapman tucks it to short mid-wicket.
Length delivery on off, Mark Chapman guides it point and denies the single.
Fuller one and outside off, Daryl Mitchell tries to drive it but gets an inside edge past the stumps and towards fine leg for one. It was inches away from knocking the stumps over.
Goes full and on middle, Mark Chapman drives it wide of mid off, the fielder there does well to stop it and keeps it down to a single.
On a length and on off, Mark Chapman blocks it to the off side.
Goes a bit short and on middle, Mark Chapman pulls it hard but it goes on the bounce to long on for a single. 15 runs from the over, a big one for New Zealand.
SIX! Huge hit! This is flighted outside off, Mark Chapman goes down and slog sweeps it over the deep mid-wicket fence for another maximum.
Tossed up on middle, Daryl Mitchell gets to the pitch of it and eases it to long on. They cross.
On off, pushed back to the bowler.
Short and on off, Mark Chapman punches it through covers for a run.
SIX! The boundaries are coming thick and fast now. This is floated on middle, Mark Chapman skips down the track and smokes it over the long on fence for a biggie.
FOUR! Short again and punished. He bowls it short and on middle, Daryl Mitchell clears his front leg and pulls it wide of deep square leg for a boundary.
A misfield and two runs taken. This tossed up full and on off, Daryl Mitchell moves across and clips it through mid-wicket. The fielder there fumbles and the batter comes back for the second.
Full and on off, Mark Chapman drills it to long off for a run.
FOUR! That is some shot! This is short and on middle, Mark Chapman picks the length early and pulls it away towards the deep square leg fence for a boundary.
Good length and on the leg stump line, Daryl Mitchell flicks it through square leg for a run.
Starts with a dot. This is on a length and on off, Daryl Mitchell pushes it to covers.
BEATEN! This is the arm ball and on middle, Mark Chapman looks to cut but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Slightly short and on middle, Mark Chapman tries to pull but gets hit on the thigh pad.
Floated on leg, Mark Chapman works it to the leg side.
A bit short and on off, Daryl Mitchell punches it to long on for one.
Floated full on middle, Daryl Mitchell tries to flick but gets a leading edge over covers. Two runs taken.
Darts this one on middle and leg, Daryl Mitchell clips it to mid-wicket.
Quicker one onto the pads, Mark Chapman keeps it out.
On middle, nudged to the leg side for a single.
FOUR! This time finds the gap. This is floated full and on middle, Daryl Mitchell gets low and reverse sweeps it behind square on the off side for a boundary.
Shortish and on off, Mark Chapman cuts it through cover-point for one.

FOUR! Nice placement from Chapman. This is a bit short and outside off, Mark Chapman makes room and punches it past point for a boundary. The sweeper cover gives chase and dives to stop it but fails to do so.
Flighted delivery on middle, Daryl Mitchell clips it to deep square leg for a run.
Michael Leask to continue. Can he make something happen again?
Full and on middle, Daryl Mitchell moves across and drives it to long on for one. Only three runs from the over.
A bit short and on off, Daryl Mitchell makes room and pushes it to covers.
Tossed up around off, Mark Chapman comes down the track and works it towards long on for one.
Floated full and on middle and leg, Daryl Mitchell eases it towards long on for a single.
Flighted delivery on off, Daryl Mitchell leans on and drives it to covers.
Starts with a tossed up delivery, full and on off, Daryl Mitchell knocks it back to the bowler.
Hamza Tahir is back on. Five overs for 27 runs and a wicket so far.
Goes short once again and around off, Daryl Mitchell easily pushes it wide of cover for one. He will keep the strike.
Short again and outside off, Mark Chapman punches it of his back foot through covers for another run.
Short and on leg, Daryl Mitchell stays back and nudges it through square leg for a run.
Floated full and on off, Daryl Mitchell tries the reverse sweep but hits it straight to short third man.
Flighted on off, Mark Chapman bunts it onto the ground and the bounce takes it over the bowler towards long off. They cross.
Tossed up full on off, Mark Chapman pushes it to covers.
Good running between the wickets. This is on a good length and outside off, Daryl Mitchell guides it of his back foot to wide of third man for a brace.
Goes full and down the leg, Mark Chapman clips it of his pads towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
On a length and on leg, Mark Chapman stays back and pushes it towards mid on.
Good length and on off, Mark Chapman knocks it to short covers.
Pulls his length back a bit around off, Mark Chapman taps it onto the ground. He wants the single but his partner denies.
FOUR! Nice shot! This is pitched up on off, width on offer as well, Mark Chapman leans on and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Flighted delivery on middle, Mark Chapman gets to the pitch of it and works it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up around off, Mark Chapman leans on and blocks it out. The dots are building on the new batters now.
A bit short and on off, Mark Chapman guides it to point.
Tossed up full and on middle and leg, Mark Chapman drives it to mid on.
Floats it up from 'over the wicket, on leg, Daryl Mitchell flicks it of his back foot through square leg for a run.
Quicker and a bit short, outside off, Mark Chapman cuts it through cover-point for one.
On the shorter side again, on off. Mitchell blocks it out.
Back of a length, around off. Mitchell dabs it towards the off side.
Bangs it short on off. Mitchell ducks under it.

On a length, on middle. Mitchell defends it left of mid-wicket. They look for a single but Mitchell sends his partner back after taking some steps forward. The fielder in the mid-wicket collects the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Chapman puts in a dive to make his ground.
FOUR! Daryl Mitchell is a man in form and gets off the mark with a boundary here. This is full on middle. Daryl Mitchell leans forward and clips it wide of mid on for a boundary.
Bangs it short on middle. Chapman pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Daryl Mitchell is the next batter in for New Zealand and Chris Sole comes back into the attack for Scotland.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! Michael Leask gets another one! What a game he is having, keeping Scotland in the game almost single-handedly. This is pitched, around off and it is a bit short as well. Cleaver goes deep in his crease and looks to cut it. However, the ball turns in sharply and catches the inside edge of the blade and knocks over the stumps. Scotland are making a comeback in this game, can they capitalise and get few more wickets quickly here?
Turning into middle. Cleaver works it with the turn towards mid-wicket.
Fuller and around off. Cleaver skips down the track and whips it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Goes fuller and around off. Chapman drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Nicely bowled! This is angling into middle. Turn and bounce there. Chapman tucks it towards short fine leg.
On the shorter side, on middle. Cleaver works it to deep square leg for a single.
Flatter and around off. Chapman blocks it out.
Angling into leg. Cleaver looks to clip it but misses. The ball brushes his pads and goes towards short fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Flatter and shorter on off. Chapman knocks it down to long on for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Chapman skips down the track and works it left of the bowler.
This is fuller on middle. Chapman works it to mid-wicket.
Floated on middle and leg, Dane Cleaver nudges it through mid-wicket for one.
Mark Chapman walks in to bat at number 4.

OUT! LBW! Michael Leask is into the action again! He did it with the bat and now he has provided a crucial breakthrough with the ball in hand. This is pitched on off and turns into Guptill. He looks to sweep it but misses. He is rapped on the pads and there is a huge appeal. The umpire raises his finger and Martin Guptill has to walk back to the hut now.
Pitches it full on middle. Cleaver drives it to long on for a single.
This is on middle. Guptill sweeps but gets a top edge. The ball goes aerially towards the fine elg region and a single is taken.
Goes a tad fuller on middle. Guptill works it to the leg side.
Turning into middle and leg. Cleaver clips it to deep square leg for a single.
Angling into middle. Guptill works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Pushed quicker and around off. Cleaver pushes it to covers.10 runs from the over!
Goes fuller on middle. Guptill knocks it down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Second boundary of the over and both batters seem to be at ease! Short and wide outside off. Guptill cuts it through point for a boundary.
On the shorter side, on off. Cleaver punches it to covers for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played! Tossed up, around off. Cleaver goes inside-out over extra-cover for a boundary.
This is slower and outside off. Cleaver drives it off the outside half of his blade to point.
Darts this one onto the pads, Dane Cleaver clips it to mid-wicket and picks up a single. They are rotating the strike beautifully.
Slightly shorter in length and on leg, Martin Guptill stays back and flicks it through mid-wicket for one.
Flighted delivery and on middle, Dane Cleaver reverse-sweeps it through cover-point for a single.
Tossed up full and outside off, Dane Cleaver knocks it to mid-wicket.
Floated but down the leg again, Martin Guptill flicks it through square leg for a run.
Starts with a short delivery down the leg side, Dane Cleaver nudges it towards deep square leg for one.
Michael Leask is into the attack now.
A single to end the over. This is tossed up full and outside off, Dane Cleaver drills it towards deep cover and picks up a single.
Floated full on off, this is pushed to covers.
BEATEN! This is looped up and outside off, Dane Cleaver looks to cut it from his crease but gets beaten on the outside edge.
On middle, blocked out.
FOUR! Nice placement there. This is pushed a bit quick and on off, Dane Cleaver makes room and opens the face of his bat to guide towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Nicely tossed up on middle and off, Dane Cleaver blocks it out.
A dot to end the over. This is full and on off, Martin Guptill knocks it to covers.
A bit short and on leg, Dane Cleaver forces it towards long on for another single.
Tossed up full and on off, Martin Guptill drives it long off for a run. With that, the 100 comes up for New Zealand.
Shorter in length and on off, Dane Cleaver pushes it through covers for a single.
FOUR! Nice timing! This is short and outside off, Dane Cleaver stays back and cuts it past point for a boundary. The sweeper cover had no chance.
Floated on middle and leg, Martin Guptill eases it towards long on for one.

Drinks break. This has been a good positive start from the Kiwis. They have lost Finn Allen but they are well on their way to chase this one. If they bat for 50 overs, they will surely chase this one down. So, Scotland need wickets and need it quickly to put pressure back on New Zealand. The overs from spinners are key here and let's see how things pan out.
Now pushes it through and on off, this is guided to point for one. So despite the boundary, only 6 from the over.
Really well bowled! Bowls it form behind the umpire, gives it air and lands it on off, it is pushed to cover.
On off, defended.
FOUR! That is a welcome boundary! Tt was a quiet period for the visitors but a boundary comes! On the pads, this is swept fine on the leg side for a boundary.
Shortish and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
That must have clipped something. Maybe pad! On the pads, Cleaver looks to flick, it goes off the pad and to the keeper.
A single to end as this is hit through covers.
Just another single to end! On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Fired on middle, it is pushed back to the bowler.
Tossed up on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
On middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
A single to end another tidy over! On off, this is pushed through covers for one. 225 needed in 210. Good phase for the hosts here.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Just the one as this is worked down to long on with the angle.
Another dot! On off, this is pushed to cover.
Fires it on middle, defended.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Mark Watt is back on. Two overs for seven runs so far.
Yes, he does! Just a single from the last ball! On off, this is cut through point for one.
Floats it on off, this is pushed to cover. Can he end the over well?
Good delivery, tossed up on middle, defended.
Dane Cleaver is the next man in.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a brilliant catch from Calum MacLeod! Just what Scotland needed, a wicket and Hamza Tahir has provided it in his first over. It is of the dangerous Allen who walks back after getting to his half ton. He steps out, does not get to the pitch of it but still goes ahead with the shot. He hits it to the right of long on, Calum MacLeod runs in, dives to his right and takes it brilliantly.
Commentary.Howout: c Calum MacLeod b Hamza Tahir

Commentary.Commentary: Well bowled! Tossed up on off, defended.
That is a lovely stop! Tossed up outside off, this is driven towards cover. The fielder dives to his left and makes a half stop. Only one.

FOUR! Nice and fine and that is fifty for Allen! Not the most fluent of fifties but he will take it. On the pads, this is worked fine on the leg side for a boundary. Yet another good over for New Zealand.
Outside off, Allen leaves it alone for the keeper.
Good length and on off, Allen defends it towards cover.
Short and on off, Guptill taps it towards point and takes one.
FOUR! Up and over! A little too full, Guptill lifts it over mid off and it races away to the fence.
There is still some movement! Length and on off, it jags back in. Guptill looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Two decent deliveries to end! Shorter and around off, Allen cuts it to point.
Flatter and outside off, this is cut to point.
FOUR! This is not good bowling, just not good! Two half-trackers to being with and now a full toss outside off, it is thrashed through covers for a boundary.
This one stays a touch low! Shorter and outside off, Allen looks to cut but is beaten.
FOUR! This is another poor delivery and put away! Not good from Greaves. Shorter and on middle, this is pulled over mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! That is a poor start! On middle, this is whipped through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Chris Greaves is into the attack now.
Slashes but misses! Outside off, on a length. Guptill goes after it but misses.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
Shorter and outside off, extra bounce. Allen slashes but misses.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
That is a beauty! This is angled into the off pole, it lands and moves away. Guptill looks to drive but is beaten.
Quick run! On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now, a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over.
Good length again and on off, blocked.
That did touch the stumps but the bail does not come off. On middle, this comes back in. Guptill looks to flick but it hits the thigh pad and then rolls onto the stumps behind. The bails do not fall.
Fuller and on middle, Allen swings, it goes off the inner half towards mid on for one.
On off, this is pushed to mid off.
Easy two! On middle, this is clipped through square leg for two.
A single to end! On off, this is pushed towards cover.
Yet another dot to end! On off, Allen defends it. A good, tidy over by Sole. Scotland need a few more of these.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Edgy runs! Length and on off, Allen looks to push at it, it goes off the outside edge down to third man. Watt runs to his left, dives and keeps it down to two.
Back of a length and on off, it is defended. Good over so far.
BEAUTY! Length and angling into off, it lands and moves away. Allen is beaten as he tries to push at it.
On off, this is pushed to covers.

Chance? Harsh to call on that! On middle, this is driven firmly back towards the bowler who sticks one hand out, it hits the hand and goes towards mid on. That had to stick. Would have been a huge wicket.
Shorter and on off, defended.
Shorter and on off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Lands it a bit full and on off, Finn Allen shuffles across to whip it to the leg side but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is a stiffled appeal for LBW but the umpire is not interested.
Outside off, this is guided to point.
Another one on a length and around off, it is kept out.
A dot to end! On a length and around off, defended.
FOUR! Not good work in the field and it results in another boundary! On the pads, this is worked through square leg. The fielder at deep square leg lets it through and it goes to the fence.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Too straight, full and on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for a boundary.
On off, Guptill is solid in defense.
Outside off, Allen looks to push at it, it goes off the outside edge down to third man for one.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for two.
FOUR! Up and over! Length and outside off, Guptill makes room and lifts it over cover for a boundary.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
On middle, this is worked down to fine leg for one.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Almost! Good length and on off, Guptill looks to defend, it goes off the inside edge, just past the off pole and down to fine leg for one.
Good length and on off, defended.
FOUR! Allen ends the over with a boundary! Back of a length, around off. Allen rides the bounce and punches it through covers for a lovely boundary.
Lands on a length, on off. Allen blocks it solidly from his crease.
BEATEN! Back of a length delivery on off, Finn Allen looks to punch it of his back foot but gets beaten due the extra bounce.
Play and a miss! Sole bowls this on a length and outside off, Finn Allen goes for the cut but misses it completely.
On a length and on middle and leg, Finn Allen knocks it down the pitch.

FOUR! Almost a wicket in his first delivery but ends up being a boundary. This is on a hard length and around off, Finn Allen goes to block it from his crease but gets a thick outside edge past the diving keeper and tha ball runs towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Chris Sole comes into the attack.
Watt bowls it a bit short, on off. Guptill chops it to cover-point. Good over, just 2 from it.
Angling into middle. Allen works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Slower through the air, around off. Guptill cuts it to point for a single.
Pushed quicker, around off. Guptill pushes it towards the off side.
Shorter in length and around off. Guptill punches it to covers.
A fuller delivery on off. Guptill blocks it off the front foot.
FOUR! Fine shot to end the over! Back of a length, around off. Allen rocks back and punches it through cover-point for a boundary.
Angling into middle from wide of the crease and Allen works it towards the leg side.
On a length, on off. Allen blocks it out.

FOUR! Allen gets away with a lucky boundary here! Back of a length, around off. Allen looks to cut but gets an inside edge of his blade. The ball goes past the stumps towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
On the shorter side again, around off. Guptill guides it to third man for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Guptill dabs it left of point.
A flatter delivery, around off. Guptill pushes it to point for a single.
Slower through the air, around off. Guptill opens the face of his blade and guides it towards the third man region for a couple.
Pushed quciker on off. Guptill blocks it off the front foot.
Tossed up, on middle. Allen works it wide of long on for a single.
A flatter one on off. Guptill defends it towards the off side and takes a quick single.
Goes fuller on middle. Guptill drives it to mid on for a single.
Who will bowl from the other end? It will be Mark Watt.
Back of a length, on off. Allen rides the bounce and blocks it towards the off side.
FOUR! Allen gets off the mark in style! This is shorter in length, on middle. Allen goes deep in his crease and works it nicely towards the square leg fence for a boundary.
On a length and drifting into the pads. Allen clips it straight to short fine leg.
Serves another length delivery, on off. Allen blocks it out solidly again.
On a length, on off. Allen blocks it off the back foot.
Sharif starts off with a full delivery on the pads. Guptill flicks it to deep square leg and gets off the mark with a single. New Zealand are underway!
